title: Red Hat Security Advisory: grafana security update
description: A security vulnerability in Grafana allows users with the Viewer role to create, modify, and delete Loki alerting rules. This issue is tracked as CVE-2026-9703 and affects Grafana as packaged in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support. The vulnerability has been rated as having an Important security impact by Red Hat Product Security. A security update is available to address this issue.
